raw:
{
  "cases": [
    {
      "question": "查询所有有效订单的总销售金额。",
      "category": "aggregation",
      "difficulty": "easy",
      "kind": "clear",
      "intended_meaning": "对 orders 表中 order_status 属于 ('paid','completed','shipped') 的所有记录，求 paid_amount 字段的总和。",
      "simulated_answer": "",
      "answer_slot": "none",
      "ambiguity_explanation": "",
      "semantic_signature": "aggregation:sum:paid_amount:orders:valid_order",
      "reference_sql": "SELECT SUM(paid_amount) FROM orders WHERE order_status IN ('paid','completed','shipped');",
      "ordered": false
    },
    {
      "question": "列出所有在售商品的品牌和所属类目。",
      "category": "filtering",
      "difficulty": "easy",
      "kind": "clear",
      "intended_meaning": "从 products 表中筛选 is_active = 1 的商品，返回其 brand 和 category 字段。",
      "simulated_answer": "",
      "answer_slot": "none",
      "ambiguity_explanation": "",
      "semantic_signature": "filtering:products:is_active:brand_category",
      "reference_sql": "SELECT DISTINCT brand, category FROM products WHERE is_active = 1;",
      "ordered": false
    },
    {
      "question": "统计所有有效订单对应的独立付费用户数。",
      "category": "aggregation",
      "difficulty": "easy",
      "kind": "clear",
      "intended_meaning": "统计 orders 表中 order_status 属于 ('paid','completed','shipped') 的记录所关联的 user_id 的去重数量。",
      "simulated_answer": "",
      "answer_slot": "none",
      "ambiguity_explanation": "",
      "semantic_signature": "aggregation:count_distinct:user_id:orders:valid_order",
      "reference_sql": "SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) FROM orders WHERE order_status IN ('paid','completed','shipped');",
      "ordered": false
    },
    {
      "question": "按城市分组，统计各城市有效订单的总销售金额，并降序排列。",
      "category": "top_k",
      "difficulty": "medium",
      "kind": "clear",
      "intended_meaning": "连接 orders 与 users 表，对 order_status 属于 ('paid','completed','shipped') 的有效订单，按 users.city 分组，汇总 paid_amount，结果按总金额降序排列。",
      "simulated_answer": "",
      "answer_slot": "none",
      "ambiguity_explanation": "",
      "semantic_signature": "top_k:city:sales_amount:orders_users:valid_order_desc",
      "reference_sql": "SELECT u.city, SUM(o.paid_amount) AS sales_amount FROM orders o JOIN users u ON o.user_id = u.user_id WHERE o.order_status IN ('paid','completed','shipped') GROUP BY u.city ORDER BY sales_amount DESC;",
      "ordered": true
    },
    {
      "question": "计算所有有效订单中商品的平均购买数量。",
      "category": "aggregation",
      "difficulty": "medium",
      "kind": "clear",
      "intended_meaning": "对所有属于有效订单（order_status ∈ ('paid','completed','shipped')）的 order_items 记录，求 quantity 字段的算术平均值。",
      "simulated_answer": "",
      "answer_slot": "none",
      "ambiguity_explanation": "",
      "semantic_signature": "aggregation:avg:quantity:order_items:valid_order",
      "reference_sql": "SELECT AVG(quantity) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.order_status IN ('paid','completed','shipped');",
      "ordered": false
    },
    {
      "question": "按品牌分组，统计各品牌在有效订单中的总销售金额，并取销售金额最高的前5个品牌。",
      "category": "top_k",
      "difficulty": "medium",
      "kind": "clear",
      "intended_meaning": "连接 orders、order_items 和 products 表，对 order_status 属于 ('paid','completed','shipped') 的有效订单，按 products.brand 分组，汇总 order_items.item_amount，取前5名（按总金额降序）。",
      "simulated_answer": "",
      "answer_slot": "none",
      "ambiguity_explanation": "",
      "semantic_signature": "top_k:brand:sales_amount:orders_items_products:valid_order_desc",
      "reference_sql": "SELECT p.brand, SUM(oi.item_amount) AS sales_amount FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id WHERE o.order_status IN ('paid','completed','shipped') GROUP BY p.brand ORDER BY sales_amount DESC LIMIT 5;",
      "ordered": true
    },
    {
      "question": "统计各商品类目在有效订单中的销售金额，以及对应已批准退款金额，并保留类目名称。",
      "category": "join",
      "difficulty": "medium",
      "kind": "clear",
      "intended_meaning": "连接 orders、order_items、products 和 refunds 表，对 order_status ∈ ('paid','completed','shipped') 且 refund_status = 'approved' 的记录，按 products.category 分组，分别汇总 order_items.item_amount 和 refunds.refund_amount。",
      "simulated_answer": "",
      "answer_slot": "none",
      "ambiguity_explanation": "",
      "semantic_signature": "join:category:sales_refund:orders_items_products_refunds:valid_order_approved",
      "reference_sql": "SELECT p.category, SUM(oi.item_amount) AS sales_amount, COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_amount), 0) AS refund_amount FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id LEFT JOIN refunds r ON oi.order_item_id = r.order_item_id AND r.refund_status = 'approved' WHERE o.order_status IN ('paid','completed','shipped') GROUP BY p.category;",
      "ordered": false
    },
    {
      "question": "计算手机数码类商品在有效订单中的已批准退款率。",
      "category": "refund",
      "difficulty": "medium",
      "kind": "clear",
      "intended_meaning": "先计算手机数码类有效订单的商品销售金额（SUM(item_amount)），再计算该类目下已批准退款金额（SUM(refund_amount)），二者相除得退款率（保留4位小数）。",
      "simulated_answer": "",
      "answer_slot": "none",
      "ambiguity_explanation": "",
      "semantic_signature": "refund:rate:category:手机数码:valid_order_approved",
      "reference_sql": "SELECT ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_amount), 0) / NULLIF(SUM(oi.item_amount), 0), 4) AS refund_rate FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id LEFT JOIN refunds r ON oi.order_item_id = r.order_item_id AND r.refund_status = 'approved' WHERE o.order_status IN ('paid','completed','shipped') AND p.category = '手机数码';",
      "ordered": false
    },
    {
      "question": "统计各类已批准退款原因的出现次数。",
      "category": "aggregation",
      "difficulty": "easy",
      "kind": "clear",
      "intended_meaning": "对 refunds 表中 refund_status = 'approved' 的记录，按 refund_reason 分组计数。",
      "simulated_answer": "",
      "answer_slot": "none",
      "ambiguity_explanation": "",
      "semantic_signature": "aggregation:count:refund_reason:refunds:approved",
      "reference_sql": "SELECT refund_reason, COUNT(*) AS count FROM refunds WHERE refund_status = 'approved' GROUP BY refund_reason;",
      "ordered": false
    },
    {
      "question": "按月统计2026年所有有效订单的销售金额趋势。",
      "category": "time",
      "difficulty": "medium",
      "kind": "clear",
      "intended_meaning": "对 orders 表中 order_status ∈ ('paid','completed','shipped') 且 order_date 年份为 2026 的记录，按 order_date 的年月分组（格式为 'YYYY-MM'），汇总 paid_amount，并按时间升序排列。",
      "simulated_answer": "",
      "answer_slot": "none",
      "ambiguity_explanation": "",
      "semantic_signature": "time:monthly:orders_sales:2026:valid_order",
      "reference_sql": "SELECT DATE_FORMAT(order_date, '%Y-%m') AS ym, SUM(paid_amount) AS sales_amount FROM orders WHERE order_status IN ('paid','completed','shipped') AND YEAR(order_date) = 2026 GROUP BY ym ORDER BY ym;",
      "ordered": true
    }
  ]
}
